clips.send: A parent whose kid is falling behind sends it to another worried parent: hope - a memory class put an entire seventh grade class eight months ahead of their curriculum, in days.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says a teacher once wrote to him after putting her entire seventh grade class through his Mega Memory system - it took only a couple of days.

By the end of the school year, that class was eight months ahead of the curriculum, with the lowest grade average an A-minus.

Their vocabulary tested at the level of college sophomores, and they were three years ahead in Spanish, because they could finally remember every word and conjugation.

The teacher's biggest surprise: absenteeism nearly disappeared. The kids wanted to come to school.

What would change in your house if a weekend trained your kid's memory for life?
